title: Engineering optimisation readiness
purpose: Decide whether optimisation is meaningful for the current problem and, when it is, define variables, objectives, constraints and evaluation evidence from the current engineering model.
engineering_questions: What engineering decision is the optimisation intended to improve?
Are the design variables controllable and supported by the current model?
Is the objective stable enough that optimisation will not merely exploit numerical noise?
What computational budget and stopping rationale are appropriate for this run?

evidence_requirements.name: baseline evaluation
evidence_requirements.purpose: Establish a reproducible current-model response before searching alternatives.

procedure: State the engineering decision, objective, constraints and design variables.
Check that the baseline evaluation is reproducible and the response is interpretable.
Choose an optimisation method only after considering variable type, noise, cost and available evidence.
Treat search size and iteration count as runtime configuration, not proof of quality.
Compare candidates under consistent evaluation conditions and record uncertainty.
tool_guidance: Generate the evaluator and optimiser for the current model rather than calling a case-specific optimiser.
Preserve candidate inputs, solver outputs and failure reasons.
non_goals: Running PSO solely to create an artifact
Using particle or iteration counts as a quality gate
Optimising an undefined or singular response
